methodology: Tracks every surfaced bottleneck candidate's initial entry price, market cap at entry, point-in-time Bottleneck Inflection Score, primary empirical source URL, falsification trigger ('What Proves It Wrong'), and subsequent realized/unrealized performance vs SOX benchmark.

historical_backtest_audit.inflection_evidence: Q4 FY20 Data Center revenue $968M (+43% YoY record) + Mellanox InfiniBand acquisition
historical_backtest_audit.kill_trigger: CUDA developer share loss >15% or Data Center YoY revenue deceleration below +20%

historical_backtest_audit.inflection_evidence: 400G/800G Active Electrical Cable (AEC) ramp at hyperscalers with +75% EPS CAGR
historical_backtest_audit.kill_trigger: Hyperscaler switch to passive DAC or Marvell/Broadcom DSP taking >35% AEC share

historical_backtest_audit.inflection_evidence: 34% GM, -35% FCF margin, Chinese SiC wafer commoditization (SICC/TankeBlue), negative EPS
historical_backtest_audit.kill_trigger: REJECTED AT ENTRY: Triggered -18 risk penalty (Chinese SiC commoditization + -35% FCF bleed)

historical_backtest_audit.inflection_evidence: >80% single-customer concentration (ON Semi EV SiC burn-in), <15% AI compute purity
historical_backtest_audit.kill_trigger: REJECTED AT ENTRY: Triggered -20 risk penalty (single-customer EV concentration)

historical_backtest_audit.inflection_evidence: 14.5% commodity server assembly GM, -8% FCF margin, accounting/auditor governance risk
historical_backtest_audit.kill_trigger: REJECTED AT ENTRY: Triggered -20 risk penalty (14.5% GM commodity box builder + governance flag)
